kind: pure ephemeral inventory projection; no persisted product record

owners.evidence: existing request and exact raw-reply digests; no new hash encoding

admission.targets: both inventory targets must equal the exact canonical capture target
admission.baseline: every exact original ID remains present with unchanged timestamp and size
admission.candidates: observed IDs absent from the baseline, in canonical raw-byte order
admission.diagnostics: no raw snapshot IDs, payload bytes or upstream error prose

bounds.complexity: linear merge over existing canonical reply views

view.ownership: borrows capture, both replies and exact candidate descriptors
view.cardinality: zero, one or multiple candidates remain descriptive; no receipt or candidate chosen automatically

integration_obligations: retain the exact original baseline before the attempted effect
authenticate network, caller, target and transport association
qualify actual observation timing and permissions
establish exclusive attribution rather than assume that another controller did not act
consume original per-call authority before effects; retain uncertain obligations
non_authority: no IO, serialization, scheduling, provider call or journal mutation
no inferred success/failure from candidate count
no capture or upload reconciliation receipt
no new paid-call, retry, restart, load, prune or release permission
